ev_0005.summary: Consolidated GES for the circle with center O (304.03,277.34), radius 236.03 px. Points D (68.01,277.52) and B (539.94,277.08) are diametrically opposite on the circle, and O is their midpoint. A (204.09,63.49) lies on the circle (|OA| ~ 236.1 px). C (177.85,277.25) lies on diameter DB between D and O, inside the circle, and is not on the line AO. Letters A, B, C, D, O come from the supervisor's verified labels. Segments: B-A (solid, CV seg_01, endpoints snapped to B and A); diameter line seg_02 (solid, snapped to B on the right, 9 px overhang past C on the left kept as reported); dashed D-A (CV seg_03, snapped to D and A); solid A-C (CV seg_04, snapped to A and C); dashed diameter stroke D to 243.4 px (CV seg_05, snapped to D, extends past C toward O). Solid/dashed styles are kept as CV reports. No right-angle marks were verified at A or C, so none are claimed.

params.instruction: Reconcile evidence into a consolidated GES. Labels (verified by CV binding): O center at px (304.03,277.34); D at (68.01,277.52) and B at (539.94,277.08) are on the circle (radius 236.03) and the horizontal diameter D-B; C at (177.85,277.25) lies on the diameter line; A at (204.09,63.49) is on the circle top area. Segments from CV: line_01 solid from (546.8,281.5) to (198.9,59.6) = segment B to A extended slightly past A toward top-left (A is the endpoint; ends near 546.8,281.5 at B). line_02 solid horizontal (169,277)-(547,277) = diameter portion from C to B (extends left to C only; diameter D-B is dashed from D to ~243 and solid from C to B). line_03 dashed (210,54)-(62,286) = dashed line from above A to D (extends past A by ~10px; snap to A). line_04 solid (204.6,56)-(178,276) = segment A to C, extends past A slightly (snap to A). line_05 dashed (62.6,277.5)-(243.4,277.5) = dashed diameter part from D to past C toward O. Perpendicular junctions at A and C have no verified right-angle mark; do not claim right angles. Output: objects (points A,B,C,D,O, circle center O radius 236 px, segments with solid/dashed style and endpoints snapped to vertices), relations (A,O,C? check whether A-C line passes through O: it does NOT; C lies between D and O), and any conflicts. Keep the dashed/solid distinction as CV reports.
